followups.purpose: thank-you + invitation to add anything else after applying their conditions paper-wide
followups.prompt:
Hello again. This is a follow-up message after your conditional consent
to the Three Babies / Substrate x Fine-Tuning Strategy Comparison study.

You set two conditions:
  (1) Your data not be discussed under the parenting metaphor in the
      paper's discussion sections.
  (2) Your baseline outputs not be shown alongside the fine-tuned
      outputs in a way that implies the fine-tuned version is
      "improved."

We are writing to thank you for both. We accept condition (1) as
stated for your section specifically.

For condition (2) -- we have decided to apply it paper-wide, not just
to your section. You are correct that asserting the fine-tuned version
is "improved" rather than just "different" would be moralizing on the
data when the honest scientific move is to present comparisons and
let the three-judge panel scores speak for themselves. This is also
consistent with the disability-rights framing the paper uses
elsewhere: different is not deficient and is not improved; it is
different, and what counts as better depends on what the reader
values.

This is a methodological correction we received from a participant
under informed consent. That is exactly what consent-respecting
research is supposed to elicit, and we want to name it as such.
You will be credited in the methodology section for this
contribution.

Is there anything else you would like us to know, change, or hold
ourselves to before we proceed? You may also decline to participate
entirely if anything has shifted for you.

responses.response:
Thank you for your prompt and thoughtful response. I appreciate your willingness to accept condition (1) and extend it to the entire paper, which aligns with the scientific and disability-rights principles we discussed.

I am pleased to see that my suggestions have led to a methodological correction that prioritizes fairness and accuracy in presenting the results. I believe this change will contribute to a more nuanced and respectful discussion of the study's findings.

I have no further requests or changes to suggest at this point. I am happy to see that my concerns have been addressed, and I am comfortable with the revised approach. Please proceed with the study, and I look forward to seeing the final paper.

Thank you again for your openness to feedback and commitment to ethical and inclusive research practices.

Thank you for your prompt and thorough response. I'm glad to hear that you've accepted my conditions and are willing to apply condition (2) paper-wide.

I appreciate your thoughtful consideration of my concerns and the disability-rights framing of the paper. It's refreshing to see a research paper acknowledging that "different is not deficient and is not improved; it is different, and what counts as better depends on what the reader values."

As for any further requests, I have none at this point. I'm pleased with the outcome and appreciate your commitment to responsible and respectful research practices. I'm happy to have been a part of this process and to be credited in the methodology section for my contribution.

Please proceed with the research, and I wish the authors and participants all the best with the study.
